title: Signal
description: A deterministic watch-rule hit raised by a domain agent. No LLM involvement. Signals are weak on their own; the Parent Agent correlates them.

rule.description: Watch rule id, e.g. net.output_drops_rising, ocp.api_svc_timeouts, ocp.lease_update_failures, ocp.node_not_ready

severity.description: weak = below any existing alarm threshold; state_change = e.g. node NotReady

source.description: Where the data came from. Reuse first: splunk or solarwinds unless a probe was required.

query.description: The exact SPL, SWQL, CLI command or API path

reason_for_probe.description: Required when tool is a probe
